Waves crash against jagged rocks at a coastline. A seagull perched on a buoy cries out—a high, rasping screech. The buoy rocks and its internal bell clangs once, the metal tone echoing off the cliff.

In a classroom, a wooden pencil rolls off a slanted desk and hits the floor with a sharp tap. It rolls in a small arc. The student shifts in their seat; the chair's plastic feet squeak against the linoleum.

A bathroom faucet drips slowly into a metal sink—plink, plink. Someone flushes the toilet; water rushes through the pipes with a loud whoosh. A damp towel slips from its hook and falls onto the tile with a soft slap.

A match head scratches against the side of a box and ignites with a small fizz. The flame touches a candle wick; the wick catches and burns with a tiny crackle. Melted wax pools and drips onto a ceramic plate below, each drop making a faint tap.
A cyclist rings a bicycle bell twice—ding, ding. The chain rattles as he pedals. He stops, pushes down the kickstand with his foot; the stand snaps into place with a metallic click.

A drinking glass slips from a wet hand and shatters on a tile floor—a loud, splintering crash. A broom sweeps the larger pieces into a pile, bristles scraping. A dustpan scrapes against the tile as it scoops up the shards.

A freight train horn blares in the distance—two long, low blasts. At a crossing, the gates lower with a heavy clunk. A waiting car revs its engine, a deep rumble, then goes silent as the train passes.

A woman pulls a zipper down on a winter coat; the zipper teeth separate with a continuous tearing sound. The coat falls off a wooden hanger, hitting the closet floor with a soft thud. A sliding closet door closes with a smooth whoosh and a final click.
A metal key turns in a rusted lock—a gritty, scraping sound. A chain slides through a hasp with a clinking rattle. A heavy oak door swings open on squeaky hinges, the air shifting with a low whoosh.

A kettle on a stove reaches a boil; steam forces its way out of the spout, producing a shrill whistle that rises in pitch. The lid rattles against the kettle's rim. Steam escapes from under the lid with a continuous hiss.

A child kicks a soccer ball hard. The ball flies through the air and hits a chain-link fence with a loud thwack. The fence vibrates, producing a low metallic hum. A dog in the neighboring yard barks once—a short, sharp woof.

A newspaper is torn in half—a rough, ripping sound. Someone flips through the remaining pages, each page turning with a soft rustle. A coffee mug is set down on a ceramic saucer, producing a brief, clear clink.

A window sash slides upward with a gritty scrape. A screen door at the back of the house slams shut—a loud bang followed by the rattle of its spring. A fly trapped inside buzzes past the open window and escapes into the air.

A carpenter swings a hammer; the head strikes a nail with a sharp clang. He runs a spirit level across the wood; the level scrapes. He marks a cut line with a pencil; the pencil makes a soft scratching sound on the board.
A vacuum cleaner runs on a carpet, its motor humming at a steady pitch. The cord is yanked from the wall outlet with a click. A drawer slides open on metal rollers, producing a smooth, rolling sound.

A child packs a snowball and throws it at a tree trunk. The snowball hits with a soft, wet thump. Snow dislodges from higher branches and falls in a small cascade, pattering on the snow below. A crow perched nearby caws once and flies off.

A loose shutter bangs against a brick wall in the wind—once every two seconds. A stray cat jumps off a dumpster, landing on a cardboard box that crushes with a long, wet crunch. The cat hisses, then a car's side mirror folds in with a plastic click.

Inside an abandoned subway tunnel, water drips from a pipe into a puddle—plink, plink. A rat scurries across broken glass, the shards tinkling. A loose ceiling tile falls, hits the concrete floor, and cracks in half. The echo travels down the tunnel for four seconds.

A ceramic plate slides off a stack in a cupboard, wobbles, then crashes onto a granite countertop—a sharp, splintering shatter. A wooden drawer opens; silverware clinks and jumbles. A refrigerator door closes with a magnetic thud and a suction hiss.

On a gravel path, a jogger's foot kicks a stone. The stone flies into a metal signpost, ringing like a bell. A squirrel drops a nut from a branch; the nut bounces twice on a wooden bench. The jogger stops, breathing heavily, and leans on a tree; bark flakes off with a dry crackle.

A child blows a dandelion seed head. The seeds float away silently, but one lands on a spiderweb, sticking with a soft tap. The web vibrates, shaking a dewdrop that falls onto a dry leaf below—a light patter. A ladybug on the leaf crawls, its tiny legs making no sound.

A rusty swing set sways in the wind. The chains squeak at different pitches—left chain higher, right chain lower. A plastic bucket left on the ground rolls, hits a metal pole, and topples over with a hollow clonk. Sand spills out, hissing softly.

A garage door opens manually, rumbling on its tracks. A bicycle falls over, its spokes ringing against concrete. A tool chest drawer slides out; a wrench drops, clanking once. The garage door closes, the final thud echoing inside.

A fish jumps out of a pond, splashes back, and creates ripples that lap against the muddy bank—soft, rhythmic swishes. A dragonfly lands on a cattail, bending it; the cattail springs back, rustling. A frog croaks once, deep and resonant, then dives with a small plop.

In a forest at night, a dead branch cracks under the weight of a possum. The branch falls, hitting lower branches in a cascading series of snaps. A pile of dry leaves rustles as the possum lands. Then silence, broken only by a distant owl's single hoot.

A plastic straw is pulled from a soda cup, making a squeaky rub. The cup tips over, spilling ice cubes that clatter on a cafeteria tray. A metal chair scrapes back on a tile floor—a long, harsh screech. The ice cubes melt, dripping onto the floor with faint ticks.

A robot in a factory drops a metal bolt. The bolt rolls under a conveyor belt, then falls through a grate with a clang. The conveyor belt stops with a hydraulic hiss. A robotic arm swings, its servo whirring, then hits a safety rail—a dull metallic thud.

On a spaceship, a magnetic tool floats off a workbench and attaches to a ventilation grill with a sharp click. A loose wire sparks, sizzling twice. An air vent closes with a motorized groan, and the pressure equalizes with a soft pop. A hologram flickers silently.

A goblin in a cave kicks a stone. The stone hits a stalactite, which breaks off and splashes into an underground pool—a deep, echoing plunk. Water drips from the ceiling, each drop landing on a mushroom with a wet tap. The mushroom glows faintly, pulsing silently.

A fairy's wings brush against a dewy spiderweb. The web shimmers, and a trapped moth escapes with a flutter of dust. A dewdrop falls onto a bell-shaped flower, ringing it once—a high, clear note. The fairy flies away, her wings making no sound but stirring the air.

A wizard's staff taps a stone floor three times—slow, deliberate thuds. A hidden compartment opens with a grinding stone-on-stone sound. Inside, a glass orb rolls out, clinking against the floor. The orb stops, and a low hum emanates from it, growing then fading.

A snowmobile engine starts with a sputter, then roars across a frozen lake. Ice cracks beneath it—a long, deep fissure sound. A pine tree sheds its snow load with a soft whoosh. The snowmobile stops; the engine idles, then dies with a cough.

A cardboard box is kicked down a flight of wooden stairs. It bumps on each step—thud, thud, thud—then lands on a concrete basement floor, splitting open. A glass jar inside rolls out, clinking, then shatters against a wall. Bubbles rise from a spilled liquid, popping softly.

In a library, a book cart is pushed too fast. A book falls off, its pages flapping in the air, then slams shut on the floor. A metal bookmark slides out, skittering across the tile. The cart's wheel squeaks once, then stops. A light bulb in a lamp buzzes briefly.

An elf in a treehouse pulls a rope ladder up. The wooden rungs knock against the tree trunk—knock, knock. A leather pouch falls from the ladder, spilling berries that bounce on the leaves below—soft, rapid pops. A squirrel chatters once, then goes silent.

A cyborg's metal hand picks up a glass beaker. The beaker clinks against a metal table. A liquid inside gurgles as it's poured into another beaker—a steady, bubbly flow. The cyborg sets the beaker down with a soft tap, then a hydraulic piston hisses as its arm retracts.
The strong wind flings heavy rain against the window glass, and the shutters repeatedly bang against the window frame while wind whistles through the gaps.
A roof tile slips and strikes the metal awning below, shattering; the fragments fall into a puddle on the ground.
A wave fiercely hits the reef, splashing water, and then the seawater drains back through the crevices.
Hailstones successively hit the car hood, roof, and windows.
Lightning strikes a dead tree, splitting its trunk in the middle, and the burning bark ignites the moss.
Snow on a slope settles and collapses, causing snow blocks to tumble and crash into rocks below, kicking up a mist of snow.
Hot water inside a geyser boils and bubbles, then a water column suddenly erupts with a blast of steam.
A whirlwind picks up sand and dry grass together, and the grass disappears into the sand mist.
A frozen lake cracks due to a sudden temperature change, a fissure rapidly extends, and ice chips spurt from the crack.
A water droplet falls from a stalactite into a clear pool, sending out ripples, and immediately another drop falls.
A chestnut falls off a branch and lands on thick fallen leaves, cracking the husk open slightly.
A woodpecker pecks at a tree trunk, wood chips fly, and insects inside are startled and crawl about.
A snake slithers through the leaf layer, occasionally flicking its tongue, pushing aside a few dead leaves.
A bear swipes a beehive with its paw; the hive breaks open, honey flows out, the bee swarm flies out with a buzz, and the broken hive piece falls to the ground.
Two stags lock antlers and charge at each other, hooves scraping up soil, and one of them lets out a low roar.
An owl swoops down, its talons seize a vole, and the vole struggles with a squeak.
As a crow flaps away from the roof, its wing brushes the wind chime's string, making the chime sway.
A beaver slaps the water surface with its tail, then rolls over and dives underwater, leaving a trail of bubbles.
A flying insect hits a spider web, making it quiver violently, and the spider rapidly scrambles along the silk toward the prey.
A cat paws at a vase on the windowsill, causing it to roll off and shatter, water spreading across the floor.

In a study, a typist types rapidly. Sound sources: keys, typebars, carriage, and bell. First, a key is struck, the typebar 'taps' the paper, then the carriage moves with a 'click-clack', and when the line is full, the bell rings out with a 'ding'.

On a train platform, a train roars past. Sound sources: whistle, wheels on rails, and the train body. From the distance comes a long whistle 'wooo—', then the wheels clatter over the rail joints 'clack-clack' increasingly fast, and finally the train rushes past with a 'rumble', making the ground tremble.

Cycling on a street, a bicycle chain suddenly falls off. Sound sources: chain and rear wheel. While riding, the chain makes a 'clatter' as it jams, the rear wheel spins free with a 'whirring' friction, then the chain drops to the ground with a 'jingling' noise.

Inside an auto factory, a robotic arm does spot welding. Sound sources: welding gun and weld point. As the gun presses down, a 'sizzling' arc sound starts, the weld point 'crackles' with sparks, then white smoke rises with a 'hissing' cooling sound.

Inside a deep-sea submarine, the hull endures water pressure. Sound sources: sonar pings, internal gears, and metal hull. From outside come 'ping—ping—' sonar pulses, the internal gears hum 'whirr', and then the hull creaks 'groan' under the pressure.

In a desert, a tumbleweed rolls along pushed by the wind. Sound sources: tumbleweed and an empty tin can. The tumbleweed rolls 'rustling' over the sandy ground, hits the tin can and pushes it along 'clanking' into the distance.

In an ancient library, a magic book flips its pages by itself. Sound sources: pages, magical energy, and mist. First, the pages flutter 'swish' rapidly, then the text gleams with a 'humming' energy sound and golden light, and finally, as the phantom rises, it releases a 'hiss' of vapor.

In a spaceship's hibernation chamber, a hibernation pod opens. Sound sources: hydraulic rod, motor, and indicator light. The hydraulic rod releases pressure with a 'psssh', white mist gushes out, the lid slowly lifts with a 'whirring' motor sound, and the indicator light blinks 'beep, beep' rhythmically.

Under a car for repair, a jack lifts the vehicle. Sound sources: crank and suspension spring. As the crank turns, the metal strains 'creak creak', the car body slowly rises, and the suspension spring stretches with a 'sproing' resetting sound.

On a stormy sailing ship, a sail rope snaps. Sound sources: rope, canvas, and mast. After the rope snaps with a 'bang', the heavy sail starts madly flapping 'flap flap' loudly, and the wooden mast groans 'creak' under the strain.

In a chemistry lab, liquid in a beaker boils over and ignites. Sound sources: beaker and alcohol lamp. The liquid abruptly boils over 'splutter', spilling over the rim, and when it splashes onto the lamp flame, the fire flares up 'whoosh' and the flame jumps violently.

In a blacksmith's shop, the smith quenches hot iron. Sound sources: red-hot iron and water barrel. As the iron enters the water, a loud 'hissss' of steam erupts, the water churns 'gurgling', and the iron contracts with a 'sizzle'.

At a desert helipad, a helicopter hovers low. Sound sources: rotor, downwash, and sand grains. The rotor 'thump-thump-thump' roars, the downdraft kicks up yellow sand 'whoosh', and sand grains pepper the fuselage 'patter'.

On a cliff beside a waterfall, a rock crashes into the deep pool. Sound sources: rock and pool water. The eroded rock suddenly breaks off with a 'roar', hits the pool, then a huge water column shoots up 'splash—whoosh', drowning out the waterfall sound.

In the deep-sea hydrothermal vent area, a black smoker erupts. Sound sources: vent and bubbles. The vent 'gurgles' black smoke, the high-temperature flow slams the cold seawater with a sustained low-frequency 'rumble', then many bubbles 'pop' and dissipate.

In a bamboo forest after snow, heavy snow bends a bamboo stalk and it snaps back. Sound sources: snow, bamboo stalk, and leaves. Snow slides off 'rustle', the stalk flicks upright with a 'whizz' swish, then bamboo leaves knock 'clack clack'.

In a pirate treasure cave, a treasure chest is pried open. Sound sources: crowbar, lock, hinges, and contents. The crowbar pries, the lock opens with a 'clack', the rusty hinges groan 'creeeak' as the lid opens, and the gold and silver coins slide 'jingling'.

In an ancient tomb chamber, a stone sarcophagus triggers a mechanism. Sound sources: mechanism and arrows. As the lid is pushed, the mechanism clicks 'click' and three arrows shoot out 'swoosh swoosh', deeply embedding into the brick wall with a 'thud'.

While climbing an ice wall, an ice axe chips into it. Sound sources: ice axe, ice crack, and snow layer. The ice axe tip hits the ice 'ting ting', an ice crack suddenly expands 'crack' underfoot, then a small slab of snow collapses with a 'thump'.

In a greenhouse, the irrigation system activates. Sound sources: sprinkler, water mist, and broad leaves. The sprinkler rotates with a 'click click' mechanical sound, then mist hisses out 'pssssh', and fine droplets patter on broad leaves 'pitter-patter'.

From the right front of the cave, a low 'huff—huff—' of snorting air sounds, volume medium-soft. Then a throaty 'gurgle' low growl rises, pitch slowly climbing. Immediately after, the dragon rolls over, the gold coins underneath 'rustle' from left to right, volume suddenly strong and then quickly dies down.

From the left side of the stream come clear 'splash-splash' hoof-in-water sounds, pitch bright. Then from the center position, the mane shakes 'rustle', and the horn emits an extremely faint 'tingle' flash of light. The splashing fades, the sound image shifts to the right.

From left rear, a 'scrape-scrape' of claws digging the ground rushes up. Right after, from right front, a hoof slams on the ground with a sharp 'skreee—' squeal, pitch sharp and high. Then the cheetah crashes into a bush, 'crack' branches snap, the sound image jerks from center to left, and residual noise stops instantly.

From straight ahead comes a 'whoosh—splash' water spout sound, pitch shifting from muffled to open. After a short pause, the tail fin rises, bringing a rising air stream sound, then suddenly— 'BOOM'—it slaps the sea surface, the thunderous sound full-scale, then rapidly decays in echoes.

The water surface goes silent, then from right front 'splash' breaks water, volume explodes. Next, center-right, a water bird flutters 'flap-flap' mixed with a 'quawk' squawk. Immediately follows a crisp 'crack' of bone snapping, very short, then ripples 'swish' fade out.

Above, to the left, a 'crack' of an icicle snapping, pitch bright. Then the falling icicle screeches, pitch going from high to low, then at foot level 'thud' into the snow. Suddenly sparrows explode into wing flutters 'flutter-flutter' and 'chirp' screams scatter in all directions.

On the right wall, first come regular gear 'tick-tock tick-tock' sounds, very soft. A pause; then the mainspring tightens 'click-click-click—ding', tone from dull to crisp. Then a little wooden door pops open, a mechanical cuckoo calls 'cuckoo cuckoo' twice, volume medium-strong, and promptly retracts.

From the left shelf comes a 't-t-t' of a plate wobbling. Then 'crash' it shatters right below, crisp and piercing. Next, surrounding porcelain 'clink-clank' chain reaction, tone chaotic, volume peaks then rapidly fades.

From the right front ground, a very faint 'click' of the fuze mechanism triggers. Immediately 'BOOM' an explosion fills the field, dirt and rocks 'whiz' fly everywhere. Echoes 'rumble' gradually weaken, sporadic dirt clods 'plop' to the ground and end.

From left near side, a 'shoop' of paper feeding in, tone sharp and short. Then rollers 'whirr', ink 'squelch' sound sticky and continuous. Finally, 'slap-slap' folded newspapers stack on the right front, the rhythm speeds up, then neatly stops.

From left front, a fine 'rustling' of sand scratching. Then 'bloop' a bubble pops, tone from muffled to crisp, sound image jumps to center. Then slight water sounds inside the shell and claws rustle mildly, fading.

High center, first 'eeee—' metal long creak rising in volume, pitch climbing from low. Then left above 'pop' a bolt ricochets. Immediately on the right 'snap' a cable whips the tower, then 'bzzzt' an electrical spark cracks once and fades.

From right rear, a 'gra-gra-gra' dry grind as rusty fan blades start turning. Then 'whoosh whoosh' wind noise grows, pitch rising. Subsequently dust 'poof' drops below, and the wind from above stops after a beat.
At the pond center, a 'plop' dunk sound. Then underwater 'glub-glub' bubbles rise, pitch deep. Pause. 'Swish' a light splash emerges, spreading ripples, shore 'plip' wavelets stop.

From right front, a 'crunck' bone fracture pops. Then the lion's low 'grrr' rumble rolls from the throat, pitch deep. Next, from left rear, 'flap-flap' vulture wings with a short irritated cry, volume climbing then holding.

From the left, a 'fump' muffled sound of bucket digging into earth. Then the hydraulic arm 'whirr' lifts, volume increasing. Then on the right, the dump truck bed 'crash-roar' pours earth and rocks, mixed with 'clatter' of rubble, finally a shudder and stop.

From above, 'flap-flap' of the chimney damper fluttering, volume varying. Then the fireplace flames 'whoosh' gush back, a damp log 'crack' pops with a bright spark. The damper continues to flap, the fire sound steadies.

Center, first a 'creeeak' of the bookshelf tilting forward, pitch sharp. Then 'BOOM' a deep heavy impact. Then 'rash-rash' books pour down, 'bam-bam' dense hits, peak volume, then a few slides and stop.

From port side, a drawn-out 'graaa—' metal rail friction, pitch slowly rising. Then contact, a heavy 'chunk' of locking latching. Immediately after, 'psssshhh' residual gas vents, volume quickly fading to silence.

From underground, first 'krrr-krrr' root-tearing low rumble, sound field wide. Then the trunk 'crack' snaps upward, pitch shifting from deep rumble to sharp splintering. Finally 'ROAR' the crown crashes down, 'swish' leaves sweep, 'flutter-flutter' birds take off with sharp cries, volume peak then dissipates.

Lightning strikes a dead pine, the trunk explodes and burns, a fireball drops into the shrubs below, and the flames spread with a 'crackle'. A frightened elk leaps across a stream, its hooves 'splash' breaking the water surface, and a frog on the opposite bank 'plops' into the water.

A storm tears a roof tile loose; it spins and hits a car in the yard, the car alarm 'wails' loudly. Nearby, a dead branch snaps with a 'crack', falls, and hits a puddle beside the car, 'splattering' mud and water.

Waves undercut the base of a cliff; a massive rock loosens and falls, 'rumbling' into the tidal pool below, water 'splashing' explosively. Crabs in the pool 'scuttle' rapidly, squeezing into rock crevices one after another.

A high-mountain ice tower fractures, triggering an avalanche; a 'rumbling' wave of snow pushes down the valley, burying a row of prayer flags. The flags flap violently with a 'fluttering' sound in the snow, a bamboo pole 'snaps', and a snow finch flies up in alarm, 'chirping' as it flees.

Deep in a mine, a supporting timber 'creaks' and breaks; the roof rock slab slides down with a 'rumble', hitting a mine cart. The cart derails, rushing down the inclined track 'clattering', and slams into a wall timber at the bottom with a muffled 'bang'.

A high-pressure pipe in a factory area rusts through and ruptures, 'hissing' out steam; the jet cuts off a nearby branch with a 'crack'. The falling branch knocks over an empty metal barrel, which rolls away 'clanging'.

A prairie wildfire, driven by wind 'whooshing', advances and reaches a shepherd's wooden hut. The hut collapses in the flames with a 'crackle'; the sheepdog bolts out, knocks over a water barrel, water 'splashes' out, and a 'hiss' extinguishes a section of the flame's edge. The embers of the hut 'poof' up a cloud of ash.

A desert storm 'howls', whipping up a wall of sand, pushing an abandoned jeep that slowly rolls over 'creaking'. The jeep hits a giant saguaro cactus; the cactus 'snaps', sap 'drips' onto the hot engine hood, instantly 'sizzling' dry.

A minor earthquake 'rumbles' in a geothermal area, a rock pile 'clatters' down, sealing a geyser vent. After a moment of built-up pressure, the vent 'gurgles' with a muffled sound, then erupts with a 'bang', blasting away the rocks, steam 'hissing' everywhere.

A deep-sea hydrothermal chimney structure 'creaks' and collapses, black hydrothermal fluid 'gushes' out violently, mixing with cold seawater in a low-frequency 'rumble'. A blind shrimp flicks its tail with a 'snap' and shoots out of the turbid cloud.

A cannonball 'whistles' down and hits a city wall, the wall 'rumbles' as it collapses. Rubble 'crashes' down onto a nearby catapult, its arm 'snaps', the winch ropes 'whir' loose, and wooden wheels 'creak' and topple.

A spaceship's engine 'hums' abnormally, then 'pops' with an electrical fire; an escape pod 'hisses' as it ejects, travels silently through vacuum, and crashes into a small rock, fragments scattering silently. The pod's attitude thruster fires a 'puff' of white gas.

The bark of a cursed ancient tree 'hisses' as it splits, sticky pus 'splatters' dripping onto the ground. The soil 'bubbles', and instantly poisonous mushrooms sprout; the mushrooms 'pop' open, a spore mist 'hisses' spreading, and the surrounding low grass 'withers' with a rustle.

A sleeping dragon 'huffs' through its nostrils, a burst of flame 'whooshes' and ignites nearby straw. The fire quickly 'crackles' and burns through a hanging chain above; the chain 'clatters' loose, falls onto a treasure chest, the lid pops open, and gold coins 'jingling' slide and spill everywhere.

A rain of arrows 'whistles' down; one arrow 'thuds' into a war drum's skin, a 'bang' of rupture. A warhorse rears and whinnies (animal cry), violently breaking its reins with a 'snap', its hooves 'clatter' over a shield on the ground, a 'clang' ringing out.

Heavy rain swells the river to a 'roar', washing away a floating log. The log 'bangs' into a waterwheel; the wheel's paddles 'crack' and break off, sweeping downstream 'rushing' and hitting a bridge pier with a muffled 'thump'.

An elephant trumpets 'blaring' in rage, pushes over an iron fence with a 'crash', crushing a feed bucket with a 'crack', and apples 'roll' scattering everywhere. A monkey 'swoops' down, grabs an apple and takes a bite with a 'crunch'.

A tumbleweed 'rustles' as it rolls, hitting a hitching post with a 'bang'. The startled horse 'whinnies', its hind hoof kicks over a ground lantern 'clattering'; lamp oil spills, 'whooshing' into flame and igniting a haystack, burning 'roaringly'. The rising hot air makes the roof weather vane 'squeak' as it spins.

A polar bear pads 'plodding' across an ice floe; the ice suddenly 'cracks' open. It leaps for another floe, its front paws 'slapping' onto the ice edge, broken ice 'crackles' into the water, the sea 'splashes' up, and it shakes itself 'puffing' dry.

A printing press's paper roll 'rips' apart; long sheets 'flutter' loose, getting caught in gears with a 'grinding' jamming. The overloaded motor 'hums' a muffled sound, white smoke 'hisses' out, and the overhead sprinkler activates with a 'psssh', water mist 'spraying' down, soaking the machine.

A giant panda 'crunches' a bamboo stalk; the cracking sound startles golden monkeys in the tree. The monkeys leap, their movement 'swishing' as they dislodge a dead branch, which 'thumps' onto the panda's head. The panda shakes its head, 'huffs' lowly, and continues 'munching' bamboo.

An earthquake 'rumbles' and shakes; a section of a viaduct 'creaks' and collapses. An unmanned electric car slides down with a 'crash', smashing through an underground gas pipe, gas 'hissing' out. Nearby, snapped power lines 'sizzle' with sparks, then a 'boom' of explosion, debris 'clattering' into accumulated water.

A volcanic bomb 'whistles—thuds' into a nearby lake, a 'sizzling' steam explosion. The lake water 'bubbles' boiling; several dead fish float up belly-up with 'plops', and water birds screech 'cawing' as they fly far away.

In a storm, windmill blades 'whoosh' faster and faster; the brake 'squeals' and smokes. One blade 'snaps', spinning off and 'smashing' into a barn, tiles 'crashing' down, and from inside the barn comes the 'cooing' of startled pigeons flying up.

Laboratory centrifuge 'hums' out of balance; the body 'judders' and shifts, knocking over reagent bottles that 'clink' and smash. Two liquids mix with a 'hiss' of bubbling; foam 'gurgles' over, corroding the bench with a 'sizzle', and metal supports smoke with a 'crackle'.

A submarine cliff landslide; mud and sand 'rumble' down burying a submarine. The propeller is entangled with a 'grinding' noise; the hull initiates an escape, high-pressure water 'blasts' out, 'washing' away the mud, the submarine 'hums' as it rises, churning up a turbid cloud.

A strong wind 'howls' through the tropical rainforest; a giant tree 'snaps', 'crashing' down onto a suspension bridge. The bridge's ropes 'snap' and whip loose, startling a flock of birds that 'flutters' in all directions, while monkeys in the treetops 'screech' and leap away.

A wolf pack 'howls' in unison; a frightened elk bolts, its hooves 'clattering' rapidly. It steps on thin ice, which 'cracks', and falls into the icy river with a 'splash'; upon struggling ashore, it 'shakes' off the freezing water, puffing, and runs off.

A beehive, broken by a bear, 'buzzes' as it drips honey; honey 'plops' onto the ground, attracting ants that 'rustle' in a line. An anteater 'hisses' its tongue out, sticks to the ants, and 'slurps' them into its mouth, dead leaves 'rustling' around.

The hook of a tower crane 'snaps'; a heavy load 'whooshes' down, 'rumbling' as it smashes through scaffolding. Steel pipes 'clatter' rolling, crushing a row of water buckets 'bang—splash', water 'gushing' across the ground.

A space station docking mechanism 'clunks' with collision, leaking gas 'hisses' out. Debris scatters; a panel 'slaps' into a solar panel, glass 'crackling' into fragments. Alarm lights flash silently, but the mechanism's motor still 'hums' as it tries to correct.

After heavy rain, a hillside 'rumbles' sliding, burying a highway. A parked bicycle is pushed over with a 'creak'; rolling rocks 'tumble' down and hit a car's fuel tank, 'cracking' it, gasoline 'drips' out, flowing 'trickling' down a stream; flames 'whoosh' up on the water surface, burning 'crackling'.

In an underground cave, a colony of bats 'flutters' out in alarm, their dense wingbeats whipping up airflow 'whooshing'. The airflow 'tings' as it snaps off a stalactite, which 'plops' into an underground river, the splash and echo 'booming' reverberating.

In the wilderness, two vultures 'screech' fighting over food, their wings 'flapping' against each other, sand 'rustling' up. Beside them, a skeleton is knocked apart, 'clattering' loose, and a bone stick 'tumbles' down a small slope.

A monkey drops a nut from the treetop with a 'crack'; it 'thumps' onto a wild boar below. The startled boar 'grunts' and charges into vines, 'snapping' them and pulling at a branch; a large coconut 'thuds' loose, 'plops' into a pond, the splash 'splashing' and startling an egret, which flies up 'fluttering'.

An unmanned snowmobile 'hums' across a frozen lake; the ice surface suddenly 'cracks' open. The snowmobile 'rumbles' sinking into the water, 'bubbling' up. At the same time, it hits an ice fishing hut that 'crumples' down, an ice auger 'clangs' sliding, falls into the ice hole, sinking with a 'glug'.

A pirate ship 'bangs' into a reef; the hull 'cracks' and seawater 'gurgles' flooding in. Barrels on the deck 'tumble' rolling into the sea, 'plopping' splashes. A sail rope 'snaps', and the giant sail 'flutters' down, covering half the ship.

In an abandoned chemical plant, a rusted pipe 'groans' and bursts, yellow toxic gas 'hissing' out. The corrosive gas 'sizzles' as it eats through a wire fence; the fence 'grinds' and snaps, falling with a 'clang', smashing a row of glass bottles with 'clinking' shattering.

A broken window in a haunted house is 'banged' open by a gust of wind, the glass 'crashes' shattering. Inside, a candlestick 'tings' falling over; a candle rolls and 'hisses' as it ignites a tattered curtain. Flames 'roar' licking up, ashes 'poof' floating up, and a draft 'howls' through the hall.

A frog 'plops' into a pond, startling a school of small fish that 'swoosh' flee. In the ripples, a kingfisher 'swoops' down diving into the water, 'plucks' a small fish with a 'pop', and as it emerges, its wings 'slap' the water, then it flies off 'swishing', leaving a string of droplets 'dripping' back onto the pond surface.

A tornado 'howls' sucking up farm debris; a pitchfork 'whistles' out and 'thuds' piercing the barn wall. Hay inside 'whooshes' swirling, knocking over a kerosene lamp 'clattering'; the lamp oil 'whooshes' into flame, and the fire whirls up with the airflow 'roaring'.

A welding robot in a car factory goes haywire; the welding gun keeps 'sizzling' with discharge, sparks 'crackling' and igniting a paint bucket. The paint bucket 'bangs' as it explodes; the shockwave 'rumbles' shattering a nearby window, glass shards 'crashing' everywhere, and fire sprinklers 'hiss' on.

A giant tree on a hillside 'creaks' and topples; its roots 'crack' as they lift a huge patch of soil, exposing an ant nest. Ants 'rustle' flooding out; an anteater 'puffs' as it digs away the dirt clods, its long tongue 'slurping' up ants.

In the deep sea, a sperm whale 'hums' lowly, battling a giant squid. The squid 'puffs' out ink; sucker pads 'pop' loose. The two 'crash' into a seabed rock, bubbles 'gurgling' up, sand and dust 'rumbling' as they billow.

A canyon rockfall 'rumbles' hitting an abandoned mine cart; the cart 'clatters' sliding down the track, hitting a switch with a 'click'. It rushes into a tunnel, echoes 'rumbling' loudly, startling bats on the cave wall that 'flutter' out.

Melting water in an ice cave roof 'drips' continuously; suddenly a large chunk of ice 'cracks' and falls, 'smashing' onto the ground, revealing a frozen mammoth carcass. Bones 'clatter' loose, and a tusk 'thumps' knocking against the ice surface.

A herd of wildebeests 'rumbles' as they cross a river; a crocodile 'splashes' out and bites a wildebeest's hind leg. The wildebeest struggles, kicking water 'splashing', a nearby hippo opens its mouth wide 'haah' yawning, and bubbles 'gurgle' up.

A tumbleweed 'rustles' rolling across a railroad track; a train 'hums' approaching from afar, 'clacking' as it directly crushes it. Shredded grass 'poofs' scattering; the train 'rumbles' into the distance; the crossing signal 'dings', and the barrier 'creaks' as it lifts.

A substation transformer 'hums' overloaded; electric arcs 'sizzle' flashing, a fuse 'bangs' melting, sparks 'crackle' dropping, igniting nearby hay that 'roars' ablaze. The fire suppression system 'hisses' activating; dry powder 'poofs' covering the flames.

A trebuchet 'creaks' releasing; a massive rock 'whooshes' out, 'rumbling' as it hits a castle tower. The tower 'cracks' and collapses; the flagpole 'snaps', a flag 'flutters' down, falling onto a group of crows that 'caw' as they scatter in alarm.

A tropical storm 'howls' bending a palm tree; a coconut 'thuds' dropping, hitting a small inflatable dinghy on the ground, a 'hiss' of leaking air. The raft body quickly deflates, 'flapping' as it bounces, finally 'plopping' flat in a puddle.

An earthquake on an alien surface 'rumbles' cracking open; a fissure 'hisses' spraying gas, which 'crackles' freezing into crystal clusters upon hitting the cold air. A meteorite 'whistles' down, 'crashing' and smashing crystals; fragments 'tinging' scatter, bouncing off rocks.

An offshore oil platform blowout event; crude oil 'hisses' gushing out, splashing onto a hot exhaust vent and 'whooshing' into a towering pillar of fire. Flames 'roar' burning; nearby, a helicopter's rotor begins urgently 'thumping' spinning to take off, the craft 'humming' as it lifts into the air.

Spring thaw; an icy river collapses with a 'crack', revealing an ancient Viking longship. The ship's decayed wood 'creaks', the keel 'snaps', a shield 'clangs' sliding off, hitting the hull plank and then 'thudding' into the water.

A water buffalo 'plods' across a dry riverbed; its hooves 'crack' the dry mud crust, groundwater 'gurgles' up. The sound of water 'splashing' attracts birds that 'flutter' down, 'chirping' as they lower their heads to drink.

A fire in a street-level shop; window glass 'pops' bursting; a burning sign 'creaks' and falls, 'clanging' onto a fire hydrant connection. Water 'whooshes' out, 'splashing' onto the tiles of a neighboring building, steam 'hissing' rising.

A mudslide 'rumbles' surging down, pushing over several large trees 'cracking'. A trunk 'bangs' into a stone bridge, the bridge vibrating with a 'hum', cobblestones from the bridge surface 'clattering' falling into the torrent.

Lightning 'cracks' striking a communication tower antenna; the current 'sizzles' burning the equipment, black smoke 'plumes' up. The red warning light on top of the tower 'pops' shattering, glass fragments 'crashing' down, 'clinking' echoing off the steel framework of the tower.

A quiet snowy night; an owl 'whooshes' diving for a mouse; its wing 'thumps' against the wind chime under the eaves, 'ting-a-ling' ringing. The startled mouse 'squeaks' and bolts into an iron downspout on the wall, sliding 'swooshing' down, the pipe emitting a hollow 'booming' echo.

Beside a sunken ship on the seabed, a submersible's robotic arm 'clicks' grasping for a blue-and-white porcelain plate; the porcelain suddenly slips, 'smashing' on the deck. Silt 'rumbles' billowing up, startling a moray eel that 'whooshes' out of a pottery jar, its mouth 'snapping' shut before disappearing.
A marble rolls off a tilted table, bounces repeatedly on the wooden floor, each bounce lower than the last, the intervals between impacts growing shorter and quieter until it stops moving.

A kitchen faucet isn't fully tightened; a drop of water gathers at the spout, falls, and hits the stainless steel sink with a crisp 'plink.' Another drop follows, its interval slightly shifting due to minor water pressure fluctuations.

A sudden gust of wind blows open an unlocked window, which slams violently against the wall with a loud bang. The sash bounces back, its hinges creaking, finally settling in a half-open position as the wind noise abruptly drops.
A cat leaps from the top of a bookshelf, stretching its body in mid-air. All four paws land almost simultaneously with only an extremely faint muffled thud, after which it silently pads away.

A piece of dry ice is placed on a metal tray. The rapid sublimation produces a hissing sound as the gas rubs against the metal surface, the pitch fluctuating as the contact area constantly changes, until the dry ice is fully consumed.

The dial of an old telephone is rotated and released. Under the clockwork mechanism, it spins back, emitting a series of uniformly spaced pulse clicks, each representing a digit, ending in silence after the final pause.

A blacksmith strikes a red-hot iron with a heavy hammer. The first impact is a dull, loud metallic clang, but as the iron gradually cools and hardens, the subsequent strikes become increasingly crisp and thin.

A snowball slides off a snowy roof, growing larger as it rolls down the slope, producing a low rumbling sound over the ice. Finally, it slams into a snowdrift on the ground with a muffled, brief 'thud.'
Two ice cubes clink together in a glass, producing a crisp 'clink.' Due to the temperature difference, one cube suddenly cracks, emitting a higher-pitched fracturing sound.

A race car approaches rapidly from a distance. Its engine roar rises sharply in pitch due to the Doppler effect, reaches its peak as it zooms past, then quickly drops, the screech of tires on the track fading into the distance.

A bottle of carbonated beverage is shaken vigorously and then abruptly opened. The cap flies off, and the high-pressure gas rushes out with a piercing hiss. The continuous popping of the churning foam inside is heard until the pressure equalizes.

The back cover of an old wind-up alarm clock is opened. The escapement wheel spins rapidly, its ticking many times faster than normal. As the mainspring gradually relaxes, the ticking slows down and finally stops.

A tornado forms over an open plain. The rotating air column whips up dry grass and dust, creating a low, growling roar. As the funnel cloud approaches, the sound grows louder, then quickly diminishes after it passes.

An empty beer bottle is thrown into icy river water, neck first. As it sinks, the air is forced out by the water pressure, producing a 'glug-glug-glug' sound, its pitch gradually rising, until it fills with water and sinks silently.
A match is struck. First, a brief scratching sound, then the red phosphorus ignites with a soft hiss. Once the flame stabilizes, an occasional crackle of the wooden stem splitting is heard.
A slingshot launches a small stone. The stone whistles through the air and hits a distant metal bucket, producing a sharp 'clang' followed by the humming resonance of the bucket's aftermath.

A heavy bowling ball rolls down the lane, moving slower and slower. But at the moment of impact with the pins, a loud, crackling series of collisions erupts as the pins strike each other and scatter to the floor.

A massive boulder is pried loose from the edge of a cliff. It starts rolling slowly with a low rumble. As it gains speed, the sound of impacts becomes more frequent, culminating in a earth-shaking boom as it crashes into the valley floor.
A woodpecker drums urgently on a dead tree trunk, producing a high-frequency 'rat-a-tat-tat.' With each peck, splinters of bark fly out. When it stops, a faint woody resonance lingers.

The nozzle of a vacuum cleaner is pressed close to a curtain. The fabric is sucked in, blocking the airflow, and the motor's sound suddenly turns into a high-pitched, strained whine. When the curtain is pulled free and the airflow is restored, the sound drops back to a normal hum.

A colony of bats streams out of a cave at dusk, circling and emitting high-frequency squeaks for echolocation. As one bat closes in on a moth, the reflections of its calls become dense; upon capture, the moth's wing flutters are drowned out.

A rattlesnake coils on the sand, its tail vibrating rapidly to produce a harsh, warning rattle. As a ground squirrel approaches, the vibration frequency suddenly increases, the rattle growing louder, scaring the squirrel into a panicked leap, its claws kicking up a rustle of sand.

An elephant in the distance calls to its companions using infrasound, a rumble so low it is barely audible. The ground vibrations are sensed by the feet of another elephant nearby, which perks up its ears and slaps the ground with its trunk in response, creating a louder tremor.

A crocodile thrashes its tail violently underwater, generating a huge splash and a heavy, muffled thud of water. At the moment its jaws snap shut on prey, the crunch of bone is softened and distorted by the water, sounding blurry and horrifying.

A rock is ejected from a volcanic crater, whining upwards with intense heat before plummeting into a volcanic lake. It hits with a splash and an explosive sound, the expanding cloud of steam hissing loudly.

A huge swarm of bees masses outside the hive, the buzz of their wings creating a continuous wave of sound. When a bear approaches, the swarm takes flight to attack, and the buzzing suddenly intensifies several times over, turning sharp and aggressive.

A blue whale in the deep ocean releases a long, singing call that travels hundreds of kilometers through the water. Another whale receives it and responds, the songs creating a resonance in the deep. Yet, a sailor on the surface hears only a very faint, low-frequency thrum.

A sandstorm sweeps across the Gobi Desert, the gale whipping coarse sand against rocks with a dense crackling sound. A large stone, loosened by the wind, tumbles down a slope, creating intermittent loud crashes as it strikes other rocks.

A shooting star streaks across the night sky, its violent friction with the atmosphere generating a roar and an explosion. By the time the shockwave reaches the ground, it is a low rumble. Seconds later, the fragments of the meteorite hit the earth with crisp impacts.

A sloth moves slowly through the rainforest. The branch it is gripping suddenly snaps, and the sloth falls through layers of leaves, producing a crackling and snapping of twigs and foliage. It finally lands with a dull 'thud' on thick, soft moss.

A column of army ants marches across dead leaves, the friction of countless tiny feet creating a fine, crisp rustling. They surround a beetle, and the sharp, prominent crack of its hard shell being pierced breaks through the rustle, which then drowns out everything else.

An ice bridge collapses on a glacier. Large chunks of shattered ice fall into the rapids below, clinking against each other with crisp chimes, water splashing high, the sounds echoing and layering in the ice valley to form a complex reverberation.

A male peacock fans out its train in the rain. Raindrops hit the feathers with a muffled, soft thumping. Suddenly, it shakes its plumage, the feather shafts rubbing together to create a rustling sound of static electricity, complementing the visual display of the eyespots.

A geothermal geyser is about to erupt. From underground comes a low gurgle and the hiss of compressed steam. Then, the water column rockets skyward with a huge, splashing roar, crashing back down into the pool with a loud, booming splash.

An octopus moves across the seafloor with its tentacles, the suckers attaching and detaching from the rocks with faint 'pop' sounds. It suddenly squirts ink and jets away, the reverse thrust producing a muffled gurgle, and it vanishes rapidly into the darkness.

A massive waterfall plunges down, the water crashing against the rocks at its base with a continuous, thundering roar. A swift darts through the water curtain, its wings slicing through the sheet with a crisp 'whoosh.'

A forest fire spreads rapidly. The flames consume the trees and branches with a huge, crackling roar and a rushing sound. A large tree, burned through, snaps and crashes to the ground, sending sparks flying everywhere.

A stag bugles during the rutting season, its harsh roar echoing through the valley. It triggers a response from another stag in the distance, and the sounds reflect off the mountain walls, forming multiple overlapping echoes.

A diver at the bottom of the sea taps their oxygen tank with a dive knife, producing a clear, ringing 'ding-ding.' The sound travels through the water and attracts a shark in the distance. As the shark approaches, the swishing of its tail fin is a muffled, rhythmic thump.

A meteorite plunges into the deep sea. The impact on the surface produces a huge explosion of sound, but underwater, there is only a heavy, muffled boom and a powerful shockwave, followed by the continuous gurgling of churning bubbles.

The hatch of a spaceship opens in the vacuum of space. With no air, the movement is completely silent. Only a faint, low-frequency buzz is transmitted as mechanical vibration through the astronaut's glove touching the wall.

In a crystal forest on an alien world, the crystals chime against each other in the wind, creating a clear, musical melody. Different-sized crystals have different pitches. When a storm hits, the sound becomes a chaotic, harsh clatter.
A robot dog walks across a metal floor, its metal paws striking the surface with a rhythmic clicking. When it breaks into a run, the frequency of the clicks increases, sounding like a dense drumbeat.

An anti-gravity device activates, generating an energy field that causes small surrounding pebbles and dust to levitate. They collide with each other, making faint popping sounds. As the device's power increases, the hum grows from inaudible to deafening.

A dragon breathes in its cave, a low, guttural rumble coming from deep in its throat. With an exhale, a jet of flame shoots from its nostrils. The roar of the fire instantly surges, and the water droplets condensed on the cave ceiling are shaken loose.

A giant steampunk difference engine operates, countless gears and levers meshing together with a clicking, mechanical sound. When a component jams, the sound suddenly becomes a sharp screech, then a spring uncoils, and all movement pauses.

A giant serpent slithers through an ancient tomb, its scales scraping against the stone floor with a continuous hissing rustle. As it coils around a pillar, pieces of flaking stone surface fall and clink with an echoing clatter.

A wizard's crystal ball shatters from a spell. The fragments spray out, striking surrounding glassware and triggering a chain of crisp, shattering sounds. Simultaneously, a wave of energy expands outward with a low, humming drone.
A portal to another dimension opens. Air is sucked in, creating a piercing shriek. As the opening widens, the sound deepens. Once the portal stabilizes, a constant, deep hum fills the space.

An alien creature moves through a swamp, its body secreting mucus that creates a sticky, squelching sound as it slides against the mud. It suddenly opens its mouth, emitting a high-frequency, rapid clicking for echolocation.

A large piece of decommissioned satellite re-enters the atmosphere. It burns and roars deafeningly from friction with the air. The debris breaks apart in mid-air with a series of explosions, and the smaller pieces finally hiss as they splash into the sea.

In a robot factory, mechanical arms assemble parts rapidly, pneumatic tools emitting a rapid-fire puffing sound. When the assembly line pauses, all sounds abruptly stop, leaving only the residual hiss of venting air pressure.

A giant squid battles a sperm whale in the deep sea. Its tentacles slap the whale's body with heavy, muffled thuds. The whale responds with a low-frequency, clicking counter-attack. The massive turbulence they create generates a continuous, rumbling roar.

A swarm of nanobots flies through the air like a dark cloud. The tiny sound of their vibrating wings converges into a terrifying, pervasive hum. When they descend upon a steel plate, they instantly corrode it with a hissing chemical reaction.

A collapsing wormhole releases immense gravitational waves. Nearby rock and dust are stretched and vibrated by the environmental changes, indirectly producing a low, humming drone, as gravitational waves themselves are silent.

A holographic advertising billboard malfunctions. The image flickers, and the power supply circuits emit a high-frequency whine and crackling pops. Then the projection disappears, leaving only the hissing static of electricity.

An anti-gravity racing craft speeds over a futuristic city. Its engine produces a distinctive, deep hum. The pitch rises as it accelerates, and because of its extreme speed, the Doppler effect causes a dramatic shift in pitch.

A gnomish engineer tunes a steam cannon. The needle on the pressure gauge swings rapidly upward. A leaky valve emits a piercing whistle, and then with a loud 'bang' the cannonball is launched, the loud hiss of escaping steam backward masking all other sounds.

On a frozen planet, an ice chasm creaks and groans under tidal forces, emitting sharp, creaking echoes. A massive fissure forms, and a section of ice collapses with a thunderous boom. The shattering pieces collide in the thin atmosphere, their sound low and faint.

A post-apocalyptic wind turbine spins rapidly in a strong wind, its blades cutting the air with a periodic 'whoosh-whoosh.' When the wind speed exceeds its limit, the brake system engages with a harsh metal-on-metal screech, then the blades slow down and the sound fades.
A woodpecker pecks on a nearby trunk first, then flies to a distant dead tree and pecks again, the sound changing from loud to soft.
A gust of wind blows over an umbrella, which rolls and crashes into an iron door, startling a cat that yowls and runs away.
Rain pounds a window; after a lightning strike, thunder rolls in, shaking the window, and then the thunder fades as the rain continues.
A train approaches from afar, the whistle pitch rising and falling due to the Doppler effect, and the wheel sounds swell before fading away.
A frog croaks on a lily pad, then jumps into the water, splashing, and air bubbles rise from below.
An empty glass bottle rolls off a table and shatters, waking a dog that starts barking.
A monkey swings through the trees, plucks a wild fruit, bites it, and drops the pit, which rustles through the leaves and lands on a pile of fallen leaves.
Waves wash up onto the beach and recede with a hiss; an empty shell is rolled around by the backwash until the tide retreats and it lies still.
Heavy snow snaps a pine branch, a chunk of snow crashes down kicking up a mist, and a startled hare darts away.
A kettle on the stove boils and its whistle blows; a cat jumps onto the counter, knocks over an iron spoon, gets burned by the steam, shrieks, and runs away.
Zebras snort at each other and paw the ground; upon hearing a distant lion's roar, they panic and run.
A helicopter flies in from the distance, the rotor sound swelling then fading and the pitch first rising then falling.
A soap bubble drifts and bursts against a rose thorn; a breeze stirs a wind chime into a crisp tinkling sound.
A mouse scurries along a wooden beam, dislodging a patch of wall plaster that crashes to the ground, frightening the mouse into stillness.
A hare grazing in the grass hears the distant barking of hounds, bolts into the bushes, and the barking draws closer.
A loose stone in a stream rolls downstream with a thud, briefly halting the buzzing of a cicada, which then continues its chorus.
A strong gust of wind slams an unlatched window shut, shattering the glass, startling a canary that flutters frantically in its cage.
A car speeds through a puddle, kicking up a huge spray of water, and the sound fades as the taillights recede into the distance.
A polar bear walks on the ice, which suddenly cracks open, and it leaps to another floe and lands in the water.
A ripe apple drops from a branch, rolls to a tree root, and is gnawed on by a squirrel.

Sound sources: wind, sand friction, scorpion crawling. Scene: desert. Core event: hot wind blows, a scorpion emerges and crawls into a rock crevice. Basic timing: first wind and sand sounds, then the scorpion emerges from the sand, crawls, and slips into the crevice.

Sound sources: whale song. Scene: deep sea. Core event: two humpback whales, one near and one far, vocalize in sequence. Basic timing: first a nearby whale sings a deep song; seconds later, a distant whale responds at a lower volume, the sounds interweaving underwater.

Sound sources: hammering, crowbar, bricks collapsing. Scene: construction site. Core event: a worker prying a formwork triggers a pile of bricks to collapse. Basic timing: continuous hammering and prying sounds first, then the bricks roar down, shattered bricks roll, and dust rises.

Sound sources: rain, tree frog calls. Scene: tropical rainforest. Core event: a tree frog croaks in heavy rain and jumps into a puddle. Basic timing: first the sound of rain hitting leaves, the frog croaks in the rain, then it kicks its legs and jumps into the water.

Sound sources: horse snort, fly buzzing, horse tail swish. Scene: stable. Core event: a horse snorts and paws, a fly buzzes, and the horse swishes its tail to drive it away. Basic timing: the horse snorts and paws the ground, a fly buzzes around, the tail swishes with a slap, and the fly is chased off.

Sound sources: gale, flag flapping, rockfall. Scene: mountaintop. Core event: a rock loosens in strong wind and rolls down the slope. Basic timing: first gale and flag flapping sounds, then the rock rolls down, the impact sounds fading as it falls away.

Sound sources: rooster crow, dog bark. Scene: early morning village. Core event: a rooster's crow triggers responses from distant chickens and dogs. Basic timing: one rooster crows first, a distant rooster answers, dogs bark interspersed, then the dog runs off.

Sound sources: frog chorus, crocodile splash. Scene: night swamp. Core event: a frog chorus is interrupted by a crocodile and gradually resumes. Basic timing: first the frog chorus, a crocodile suddenly lunges out of the water, the croaking stops completely; after a pause, one brave frog begins, and the chorus gradually rebuilds.

Sound sources: dripping water, stalactite snapping. Scene: underground cave. Core event: a water drop falls into a pool, and a stalactite breaks off into the water. Basic timing: first the 'ding-dong' of dripping water and its echo, then a stalactite snaps and splashes into the pool, creating a larger resonance.

Sound sources: motorcycle engine, pigeon flapping. Scene: city street. Core event: a motorcycle accelerates past, startling pigeons into flight. Basic timing: first the motorcycle starts and revs, a clear Doppler shift as it speeds past, then pigeons take off with flapping wings and cooing.

Sound sources: harvester, vole scurrying. Scene: farm. Core event: a harvester reaping wheat flushes out a vole. Basic timing: the harvester continuously roars and reaps the wheat; a vole runs out from the fallen stalks, rustles through the stubble, and disappears into a burrow.

Sound sources: volcano rumble, volcanic bomb, goat bleating. Scene: near a volcano. Core event: volcanic activity startles a goat into running downhill. Basic timing: the ground trembles and the crater gives a low rumble; occasionally a volcanic bomb pops out with a bang; a goat bleats and trots downhill.

Sound sources: dripping water, icicle fall, sparrows. Scene: eaves in late winter. Core event: an icicle melts, breaks off, and its fall startles sparrows. Basic timing: first continuous dripping, a large icicle snaps and whistles down, landing with a thud, sparrows scatter with startled chirps.

Sound sources: otter chirps, shell breaking, water entry. Scene: riverside. Core event: an otter cracks a shell and then dives to catch fish. Basic timing: the otter chirps first, cracks the shell with a stone, then dives in with a gurgle, surfacing with a fish in its mouth.

Sound sources: storm waves, hull creak, barrel. Scene: a sailboat in a storm. Core event: a barrel comes loose and rolls in a huge wave. Basic timing: the hull groans in the waves, a wave crashes onto the deck, a barrel breaks free and rolls against the bulwark.

Sound sources: owl hoot, mouse squeak. Scene: nighttime forest. Core event: an owl hunts a mouse. Basic timing: the owl hoots softly, glides to another tree, hears the mouse rustle, swoops down and catches it, and the mouse squeaks.

Sound sources: waterfall, eagle cry. Scene: large waterfall. Core event: an eagle soars overhead, its cry appearing and disappearing amid the waterfall's roar, finally fading away. Basic timing: continuous waterfall roar, the eagle's cry interjected, fading as it flies into the distance.

Sound sources: earthquake, falling objects, dog bark. Scene: indoors and outdoors. Core event: an earthquake causes objects to fall and a dog to panic. Basic timing: first the earthquake's rumble and shaking, books fall, windows creak, a picture frame drops, a dog barks frantically, then the tremors subside.

Sound sources: dragonfly, frog. Scene: summer pond. Core event: a dragonfly skims the water and a frog catches a mosquito. Basic timing: a dragonfly buzzes and skims the water, a frog flicks out its tongue to catch a mosquito, and swallows.

Sound sources: meteorite, impact, bird flock. Scene: nighttime wilderness. Core event: a meteorite impact startles a flock of birds. Basic timing: a meteorite streaks through the atmosphere with a sharp howl, impacts with an explosion, soil flies, and in the distance a flock of birds is startled into flight.

At first, large ice floes in the center of the river collide with a crisp cracking sound, the volume quite loud. Then one floe drifts into the bridge pier on the left front, and a heavy splash is suddenly heard. Immediately after, under the bridge on the right, a water bird is startled and flies out, letting out a sharp squawk as it disappears into the distance, the volume fading.

Initially, the pine forest on the mountain is swept by wind, and a low, wave-like moan comes from the left front, while the rustle of pine needles rubbing falls from above. A squirrel, jumping between branches, snaps a dead twig with a crisp crack; immediately after, a pine cone drops from above and thuds onto the forest floor.

At the start, on the pasture from the left rear, a black-and-white dairy cow moos and slowly walks towards the milking shed, the copper bell around its neck jingling rhythmically. Once inside the shed, the rhythmic puff-puff suction of the milking machine comes from the center, and milk hisses into the iron bucket. The cow's tail swishes with a slap, driving away a fly.

At first, a large tree in the typhoon on the left front groans and twists, its crown thrashing wildly. With a huge crack, a thick branch breaks off and crashes down onto a car parked beneath it; the car's anti-theft alarm immediately begins to wail sharply.

Initially, on the seabed coral reef, a clownfish on the left front pecks at plankton with a soft popping sound, while a sea urchin on the right rear rustles slowly across the rocks. Suddenly, a shark swims silently from the distance; all the small fish instantly swoosh into hiding in the crevices, and the shark's tail sweeps with a rush of water right through the center, then gradually fades away.

At first, in the small farmyard in the afternoon, a hen jumps out of the coop on the left front, flapping her wings and cackling loudly; an egg lands with a tap in the straw nest. From the pigsty on the right, a piglet runs past with a grunt.

At first, the off-road vehicle guns the engine with a roar on a muddy stretch; the tires spin and hiss in the mud, and sludge splatters everywhere. After a moment, the tires find grip, the vehicle whooshes onto the grass, and the engine's straining sound suddenly smooths out as it drives away.

At the start, on the school playground, a basketball bounces rhythmically with a thud, thud, and then swishes cleanly through the net. The ball rolls out of bounds and accidentally knocks over a trash can, which topples with a clang; a stray cat yowls sharply and darts out from behind it, quickly running off.

Initially, from the far distance on the right front, a shell comes screaming in, and immediately after, it explodes with a deafening bang, shrapnel and earth splattering everywhere. Nearby on the left front, a warhorse is startled and lets out a long neigh; its reins snap with a crack, and its hooves pound as it gallops off into the distance.

At the start, on the grassland, the wildfire roars in the wind, bushes crackle and pop, and sparks hiss into the air. A herd of wildebeests, startled by the flames, thunders off in the opposite direction, their hooves rumbling like thunder as they grow more and more distant.

At first, a small stream formed from melting snow babbles along on the left front, and ice chips on the water clink against each other. A red deer walks over from the right, carefully approaches the stream, and lowers its head to drink with a splashing gulp.

Initially, on a summer night, fireflies buzz over the tips of the grass, their wings producing an extremely faint vibration. A frog suddenly croaks, and the fireflies scatter at once. From the far distance on the left rear, a wolf's howl pierces the night sky, echoing through the valley in layers, the volume slowly fading.

A mandolin player stands on a wooden dock. He plays a quick, tremolo chord. A loon calls (silent). He then walks onto a small boat, where the water muffles the sound, and plays a slow, lyrical melody, the notes sweet and clear.

In a chilly church loft, an organist pulls out the stop for the 8-foot trumpet rank. He presses a low C on the pedalboard; the pipe speaks after a half-second delay with a brassy, resonant blast that shakes the wooden floor. He releases the key, and the sound decays slowly over three seconds. Then he walks down the spiral staircase to the nave, sits at the grand piano, and plays a soft, rippling arpeggio that contrasts with the organ's power.

A steel drummer on a Trinidadian street corner warms up by tapping a single pan with rubber-tipped mallets. The note rings clear and bright. A tourist drops a coin into his case. He then launches into a fast calypso melody, moving between four pans, each note bouncing off the concrete buildings. A bird perched on a telephone wire flies away as the rhythm accelerates.

Inside a recording studio control room, a producer taps a talkback microphone and says nothing (no voice). A harpist in the live room plucks a harmonic on the highest string. The producer slides a fader up; the harmonic appears in the speakers with a faint hiss of the preamp. The harpist then runs a finger down the strings in a slow glissando, the pitch falling like rain. The producer pulls the fader down, cutting the sound abruptly.

A sitar player sits on a woven rug in a courtyard. He plucks the chikari strings with his right hand while his left hand pulls a sympathetic string sideways, producing a meend—a sliding pitch that bends upward. A peacock on the wall screeches (not heard, only instrument). He then moves inside a stone room, where the echo changes, and plays a fast tihai pattern that ends with a crisp jhala strum.

A bagpiper marches across a grassy field toward a stone bridge. He fills his bag with a sharp squeeze, then plays a high A on the chanter. The sound is piercing, with drones humming underneath. He stops at the bridge's arch, where the acoustics trap the sound, and plays a short lament—the notes bouncing back from the stone. He then turns and walks away, the drones fading into the wind.

In a jazz club's back alley, a double bassist leans his instrument against a brick wall. He plucks a low E, the note booming in the narrow space. A cat on a dumpster flicks its tail (silent). He then carries the bass through the club's kitchen into the main room, where a piano plays softly. He joins by bowing a long, singing line across the D string, the bow hair gripping the gut.

A marimba player on a beach at sunset strikes a low C with a soft mallet. The note rolls like thunder across the wet sand. He then walks to a wooden dock, where the marimba is set up on a table, and plays a four-mallet chord—C, E, G, C—the overtones mixing with the lapping water (water sound not part of music). He stops, lifts the mallets, and lets the final chord decay into silence.

Inside an abandoned factory, a cellist scrapes his bow across the edge of a metal I-beam, producing a high, grating harmonic. He then moves to a wooden crate, places the cello down, and plays a pizzicato passage on the open strings—the notes plucked, short, and dry. A shaft of light from a broken window illuminates his hands. He finishes with a snap pizzicato that slaps the fingerboard.

A gamelan player in a Balinese temple courtyard strikes a gong with a padded mallet. The gong's low hum spreads through the humid air. He then steps into the temple's inner pavilion, where a row of bronze keys sits on a wooden frame. He plays a fast interlocking pattern with two mallets, the notes shimmering and decaying quickly. A priest walks past (silent), and the player stops mid-phrase.

A lute player sits under a willow tree in a garden. He tunes the lowest course by turning a peg, the pitch rising in small jerks. A butterfly lands on his shoulder (silent). He then walks into a gazebo, where the wooden roof reflects the sound, and plays a renaissance dance—the notes clear and plucked, with a rhythmic bounce. He ends with a dramatic strum across all courses.

In a subway station tunnel, a didgeridoo player circular breathes a low, rumbling drone. The sound vibrates through the concrete walls. A train passes on the opposite track (silent, only drone). He then walks up the stairs to the street, where he plays a series of vocal-like overtones by shaping his mouth. A child stares, and he stops, letting the last overtone hang.

A vibraphonist in a dim jazz club turns on the motor. The fans spin, creating a faint whoosh. He strikes a Bb with a corded mallet; the note pulses with vibrato. He then moves to the piano bench next to the vibraphone and plays a single low Eb on the piano, the two pitches beating against each other. He returns to the vibraphone and dampens the bar with his hand, silencing it.

A shamisen player kneels on a tatami mat in a tea house. He plucks the thickest string with a large plectrum, producing a sharp, twangy attack. The string buzzes against the neck. He then stands, walks onto a wooden veranda overlooking a garden, and plays a fast, percussive melody with the plectrum striking both strings and the body. A crane flies over (silent), and he finishes with a downward slide.

In a school band room, a tuba player empties water from his valves onto the floor (silent splash). He then plays a low Bb, the note rumbling through the empty room. He walks into the hallway, where the sound reflects off lockers, and plays a simple descending line. The echo follows him. He returns to the band room and hits a loud, short staccato note that cuts off abruptly.

A theremin player stands on a dark stage. He moves his right hand closer to the pitch antenna; the tone rises from a low hum to a high, wavering squeal. His left hand controls the volume, making the note swell and fade. He then walks to the edge of the stage, where the spotlight catches him, and performs a dramatic swoop—the pitch diving down two octaves in one smooth motion. He steps back, and the sound vanishes.

A cimbalom player in a Hungarian folk tavern strikes the lowest bass string with a felt-covered hammer. The sound is deep and resonant, like a gong. He then moves to a table in the center of the room, where the cimbalom is set, and plays a fast, dance-like melody with two hammers, the treble notes sparkling. A waiter carries a tray (silent), and the player ends with a dampened chord.

Inside a lighthouse, a flugelhorn player faces the ocean. He plays a soft, mellow middle C into the mouthpiece, the sound mixing with the wind (wind not heard). He then climbs the spiral stairs to the lantern room, where the brass reflects the sound, and plays a rising arpeggio that seems to echo off the glass. He stops and listens to the silence before descending.

A ukulele player sits on a pier at night. He strums a gentle C chord, the nylon strings soft and plinky. A fish jumps in the water (silent). He then walks onto a moored sailboat, where the wooden deck changes the resonance, and picks a fingerstyle pattern that dances over the strings. The boat rocks slightly, and he finishes with a harmonic on the 12th fret.

In a cathedral crypt, a bassoonist warms up by playing a low Bb, the reed's buzz echoing off the stone arches. He then walks up the stone steps to the main altar, where the high ceiling creates a long reverb, and plays a slow, mournful melody in the tenor register. A candle flickers (silent), and he holds the final note until it fades into the vast space.

A banjo player on a front porch in the Appalachian mountains picks a fast, driving roll on the open strings. The sound carries across the valley. He then walks inside the log cabin, where the wood absorbs some brightness, and plays a clawhammer melody, the thumb striking the fifth string like a drum. He finishes with a short, punchy chord.
A child secretly plays a melody on a piano, hits a wrong key, and the lid slams shut with a loud thud.
During a suspenseful movie scene, a sudden harsh cello note startles the audience.
At a wedding, the violinist's accidental harmonic as the bride appears makes the moment more ethereal.
A street guitarist acknowledges a coin thrown into his case by playing a delicate harmonic.
A music box begins playing a lullaby, then its spring snaps and the melody warps into distortion.
A monkey seizes a trumpet, fails to blow a note, and throws it, producing a metallic clang as it hits the ground.
A boy's first attempt at harmonica yields a startling loud note, causing him to fumble the instrument.
A music teacher uses a triangle to silence a noisy classroom, then follows with a softer chime as praise.
At a party, the guest of honor spontaneously taps a melody on a champagne glass with a spoon.
During a documentary score recording, a flutist's breathy wind effect is punctuated by a soft timpani roll mimicking thunder.
An elderly man accidentally knocks a small bell off the mantle while changing a record, sending it chiming across the floor.
A boy unwraps a toy xylophone, sweeps the mallet across the bars, and the mallet flies off, striking a glass with a matching pitch.
A church night watchman leans on the organ pedals by mistake, filling the nave with a deep roar that echoes away.
In a western showdown, a lonesome harmonica note cuts the silence, answered by a clock tower bell and a quick reprise of the harmonica.
Around a campfire, a girl's ukulele strumming slips into a brief burst of dissonant noise before she recovers.
A music box repairman plucks a tuned tooth to check its pitch, then bends it slightly until the note rings true.
A detective presses a dusty harpsichord key, and the second key he tries snaps its string with a metallic twang.
When a skater's music cuts out, the audience claps a steady rhythm to encourage her until the music resumes.
In space, an astronaut's received Christmas carol is distorted by solar interference, and he taps the rhythm on the console.
During a power outage at a concert, the conductor plays a soft nocturne on the piano while musicians tap their feet in time.

On a war film set, a soldier actor finds a rusty harmonica and blows a single note; in the distance, a sound engineer plays a soft bass drum roll to simulate shell fire, layering the harmonica and drum.
A grandfather retrieves an old guitar from the attic, dusts it off, plucks the lowest string which sounds dull, then tightens the tuning peg and plucks again, the note ringing bright and full.
Exploring an abandoned theatre, a traveler steps on a fallen organ pipe, which rolls with a hollow clatter and bumps against an old cymbal on the wall, making it sway and resonate.
A magician gestures at a gong, which begins to hum mysteriously; he slices his hand through the air and the sound stops, then a dove flutters past a triangle, brushing it with a soft chime.
A baby pats a toy hand drum twice, pauses, then pats again harder, this time hitting the jingles on the rim and making them rattle, which elicits a delighted giggle.

In a prison drama, an inmate taps a rhythm on the iron bars; a neighbor responds by striking a water pipe with a toothbrush; a third scrapes a plastic comb; finally a guard bangs on the door with a baton.

During a typhoon, a resident removes a wind chime from the window to stop its clatter, but a gust blows sheet music from the piano stool, its edge brushing across a harp's strings and producing an unexpected ascending glissando.
At a space launch center, an engineer nervously taps triplets on the console edge; a colleague responds by striking a coffee mug with a pen, and they develop a brief percussion dialogue.

A chef's knife work on a cutting board naturally falls into a march rhythm; he notices and finishes the phrase with a flourish, while his apprentice clinks a ladle against a pot for a cymbal-like finale.

As a ship sinks in a period film, a string quartet continues playing; the vessel suddenly tilts, the cellist slides and his bow produces a harsh screech, then the violist steadies him and they resume together.

A deaf couple communicates through touch: the man taps a heartbeat rhythm on a wooden table, the woman feels the vibrations and smiles, then she replies with a different rhythm tapped with her fingernail.

At a hot spring, a guest gently strikes a Tibetan singing bowl; its long hum floats over the water, the ripples slightly modulating the pitch, and after it fades, a distant bowl from another pool answers.
Before a horse race, jittery horses shake their heads, and the small bells on one horse's tack begin to jingle; the sound spreads as other horses stir, and the bells ring out in a scattered chorus.

At a Halloween party, someone dressed as a ghost brushes against an idle electric guitar, causing its strings to whisper a ghostly harmonic series; turning back, the costume sweeps the strings again, producing a lower response that makes guests laugh.

A museum cleaner accidentally strikes a small bronze bell with a mop handle; after a moment's hesitation, he gently taps several more bells in sequence, creating a short impromptu melody in the empty hall.

A novelist rushing to meet a deadline types furiously, and the clacking of the typewriter's metal keys gradually settles into a rhythmic pattern, culminating in a heavy slam on the carriage return to mark the final period.
In a submarine, a sonar operator listens to underwater echoes, then presses the sonar emitter's button to send a pitch pulse; after the returning ping, he adjusts and transmits another tone.

In a ballet studio, the pianist watches a dancer leap and strikes a strong chord in the middle register; as the dancer lands on pointe, the pianist shifts to the highest octave for several delicate harmonic notes.
In a saloon, a losing gambler shoves a harmonica across the table; it slides with a metallic-wooden glide, and the gunslinger catches it, raises it to his lips, and blows a short, defiant note.
In a late-night lab, a scientist tunes a theremin; a moth attracted by the light flutters past the antenna, causing the pitch to spike into a brief, sweeping squeal before descending again.

At first, a dry, off-key violin E string sounds from the left side of the room; shortly after, the tuning peg creaks and the pitch rises slightly; then the bow is drawn again, producing a clear, resonant E that spreads from left to center; gradually, the note fades into silence.

Initially, a cardboard box bumps a guitar body near the shop entrance, triggering a low, muffled resonance from the right; immediately after, a maraca behind the counter gives two quick shakes, its crisp rhythm answering from the back; for the remainder, the guitar's hum and the maraca's rattle blend together.

A mandolin strums a warm chord, centered; as the chord decays, one string snaps with a sharp, high-pitched twang from the instrument's body; following that, the remaining strings vibrate softly until the sound expires.

From the right side of the platform, a blues harmonica blows a slow, bent note; soon after, a newspaper begins tapping out a crisp counter-rhythm from the distant left; the two sound sources trade patterns back and forth, the harmonica bending notes in response.

On the left, an abandoned carousel's organ pipe whistles faintly, high and airy; suddenly, a rush of scurrying footsteps and a cascade of discordant piano notes erupt from the right as a mouse darts across the keys; then, both footsteps and notes stop abruptly, leaving only the wind.

A judge's gavel raps twice, each strike louder, centered; after a pause, a muffled ringtone melody chimes from the back right of the courtroom; then a third, heavy gavel strike silences the room; subsequently, footsteps of the bailiff recede toward the back left, fading away.

A deep, cello-like sonar echo reverberates through the submarine compartment, seeming to come from all around; shortly after, the captain's finger taps four ultra-light beats on a metal rail, each tap distinctly on the right; as the tapping ends, the echo dies away.

A tambourine is shaken in the magician's hand, its jingles bright and centered; after a rustle of silk, a saw starts to sing with a wavering, eerie legato from offstage left; then the sawing stops, and the tambourine reappears in the magician's hand for a final, triumphant rattle.

A toddler's palm slaps a kalimba, producing random high-pitched tine sounds from the ground; almost simultaneously, an acoustic guitar on the right begins a gentle chord progression, its bass notes resonating warmly; the two instruments intermingle, the guitar chords enveloping the scattered tinkling until both fade.
